name: switchboard-remote
description: Makes a remote chat's tab act like a local chat's: closing it closes the chat, and an image pastes into it.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Acts only on terminals Claude Switchboard lists in ~/.claude-switchboard/remote-tabs.json; it reads nothing from the workspace.

commands.title: Paste (an image goes to a remote chat as a file)
Paste an image with Ctrl+V into a remote chat
